salient_findings: Diffuse extraoral swelling over the right cheek
Solitary, mobile, submucosal mass on the right buccal mucosa
key_facts: 30-year-old woman
2-month history of swelling in the right cheek
Severe pain associated with the swelling
Diffuse extraoral swelling over the right cheek
Solitary, mobile, 2 cm × 2 cm submucosal mass
Mass located on the right buccal mucosa
Smooth mucosal surface without color change
Well-defined, hypoechoic lesion on ultrasonography

differentials: Polycystic disease of the salivary glands
per_call: Polycystic disease of the salivary glands

shortlist.label: Lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches clinical description of a mobile, submucosal mass

shortlist.label: Ectopic lymph node
shortlist.why_kept: Considered in differential diagnosis based on clinical and radiographic findings

shortlist.label: Mucocele
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of a swelling in the cheek with a smooth mucosal surface

shortlist.label: Sialadenitis
shortlist.why_kept: Could explain the severe pain and swelling in the cheek region

shortlist.label: Pleomorphic adenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Common salivary gland tumor that could present as a submucosal mass

raw.rationale: The presence of a solitary, mobile, submucosal mass with ill-defined borders and a smooth mucosal surface, along with severe pain and a well-defined, hypoechoic lesion on ultrasonography, is more consistent with a pleomorphic adenoma, which is a common salivary gland tumor that can present with these characteristics.

rejected.label: Lipoma
rejected.why: Lipomas are typically painless and have well-defined borders, which does not match the patient's presentation of severe pain and a mass with ill-defined borders.

rejected.label: Ectopic lymph node
rejected.why: Ectopic lymph nodes are rare and usually do not present as a solitary, mobile mass with severe pain.

rejected.label: Mucocele
rejected.why: Mucoceles typically present as a fluctuant, painless mass, which does not match the patient's presentation of a firm, painful mass.

rejected.label: Sialadenitis
rejected.why: Sialadenitis is inflammation of the salivary gland, which usually presents with swelling, pain, and tenderness, but the presence of a solitary, mobile submucosal mass is not typical of this condition.
